title: AI can combine mathematical ideas on a scale beyond individual human minds. But could it produce ideas likes Einstein?
summary: It once struggled to get simple sums right. But AI is now tackling tough mathematical problems like the Riemann hypothesis. How AI made this extraordinary leap. And why mathematicians should be "deeply worried."

title: Airline Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy, succumbing to aviation fuel costs
summary: The low-cost airline was only founded a few years ago and had been struggling to turn a profit. The spike in aviation fuel prices caused by the war in Iran has now driven Norway's Norse Atlantic into bankruptcy.

title: BSW set to play major role in German politics once more
summary: Sahra Wagenknecht's BSW party is set to disrupt German politics yet again. Espousing a mix of left-wing economic policy and populist far-right anti-migration rhetoric, it now stands to play kingmaker to the far right AfD

title: Duterte's ICC trial: What is at stake for the Philippines?
summary: Former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte faces trial in The Hague over his deadly war on drugs. The proceedings could also determine the political fortunes of one of the Philippines' most powerful dynasties.

title: Georgia: Police clash with Besiktas fans at Israel club game
summary: Turkey's Besiktas accused Georgian police of using "disproportionate" force during the game with Israel's Hapoel Beer-Sheva, which saw Besiktas fans unfurl a banner supporting Palestine.

title: German Catholic Church: Abuse victims may receive higher compensation
summary: In a landmark ruling, judges in Cologne found the Catholic Church responsible for abuse committed by clergy members. Victims could now be entitled to more compensation.

title: German lawmakers approve debt-laden 2027 budget
summary: German lawmakers voted on a federal budget which foresees €556 billion in spending. Elsewhere, the Left Party is hosting a summit on femicide and the BSW party conference starts in Dresden. DW has more.

title: Germany news: Parliament to vote on €556 billion 2027 budget
summary: German lawmakers are set to vote on a federal budget which foresees €556 billion in spending. Elsewhere, the Left Party is hosting a summit on femicide and the BSW party conference starts in Dresden. DW has more.

title: Historic €550,000 ruling: German court holds Catholic Church liable for priest's abuse
summary: In a landmark ruling, judges in Cologne found the Catholic Church responsible for abuse committed by clergy members. Victims could now receive higher compensation.

title: How East Germany boosted Vietnam's coffee industry
summary: When East Germany could no longer afford to import coffee, it introduced a substitute blend containing rye and chicory in 1977. A public outcry ensued. The solution to the problem lay 9,000 kilometers away — in Vietnam.

title: India's Modi government calls special sitting of parliament
summary: The sitting of the Indian parliament comes after its monsoon session was adjourned indefinitely in August. Follow DW.

title: Indian workers fill Germany's labor gaps but face hurdles and risks
summary: The number of Indians working in Germany has grown rapidly in recent years. But many continue to face challenges in the labor market. Some also fall victim to recruitment scams, leaving them vulnerable to exploitation.

title: New Zealand election ends in hung parliament
summary: A final vote count showed that neither the center-right bloc nor the opposition left bloc was able to secure a majority.

title: On the arrest of Informer TV owner and editor-in-chief Dragan J. Vucicevic: Has the reckoning with Serbia's pro-Vucic media machine begun?
summary: The arrest of media owner Dragan J. Vucicevic raises questions about whether Serbia is holding the people behind the country's pro-Vucic media accountable or whether this is another political power struggle.

title: Philippines: VP Duterte says father's ICC case 'not a fair trial'
summary: Sara Duterte has said the ICC will not give her father a fair trial and that the Hague-based court wants to "make a statement." Duterte alleges the case against her father is politically motivated.

title: Risks of child marriage in Iran complicated by war
summary: War, poverty and disrupted schooling could put more girls in Iran at risk of child marriage, rights advocates warn.

title: The Gambia election: Can Barrow secure a third term?
summary: President Adama Barrow is seeking a third term as Gambians vote on December 5. The election will test the opposition's appeal and the country's progress on democratic reform.

title: Ukraine's Heraskevych hails EU pushback against Russian athletes
summary: As European countries challenge Russia's sporting return, Ukrainian Olympian Vladyslav Heraskevych believes the IOC is facing a 'very big crisis.'
